title: use golang built-in functions rather than mathutil
body:
## Enhancement

like we can use `max` rather than

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/7158ac65ee454d38455cd636b562649b08906e18/pkg/util/mathutil/math.go#L71-L80

comments.body: I have worked on this issue @reporter

I'll take a look at Monday

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: @reporter  I have updated the code using inbuilt function and it is running without errors. Please check it

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: @participant1 Please read the issue. Use golang built-in functions like https://<redacted-host>/builtin#max. And delete `mathutil. Max`

comments.author: participant1
reporter
comments.body:
> Do I need to do the same for this file only? [tidb/pkg/util/mathutil/math.go]

No. Delete `mathutil.Max` and let caller use golang built-in `max`. Also for `min` and other proper functions.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: @reporter I was working on this issue. This is the first time I am working on issue for TiDB. Please reassign it to me

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
@reporter are you talking about this change:

`result := math.Max(float64(a), float64(b))`

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
> @reporter are you talking about this change:
> 
> `result := math.Max(float64(a), float64(b))`

I don't know where's the code you refer to. I think the issue is clear and I don't know how to provide more details

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: Okay, thanks for the clarification! So, @participant1 you have to delete mathutil.Max and mathutil.Min and replace them with Go's built-in max and min functions

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
> Okay, thanks for the clarification! So, @participant1 you have to delete mathutil.Max and mathutil.Min and replace them with Go's built-in math.Max and math.Min functions

The built-in functions are called `max`, `min` rather than `math.Max` and `math.Min`

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
> > Okay, thanks for the clarification! So, @participant1 you have to delete mathutil.Max and mathutil.Min and replace them with Go's built-in math.Max and math.Min functions
> 
> The built-in functions are called `max`, `min` rather than `math.Max` and `math.Min`

@reporter the built in `max` and `min` are not variadic in nature. So how will I implement it here for variable n set of arguments?

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: Obviously `max` and `min` ARE variadic in nature. Please learn some basic golang knowledge before you contribute.
